pages.text: The Lumenwilds lies in perpetual dim twilight beneath Veyra, an oversized pale moon. A weak, blurred sun crosses the sky, but the world lives by moonlight — it is never truly day.
Its day also runs at half speed (a 48,000-tick cycle), so nights are long. Sleeping won't skip the Lumenwilds' clock.

Watch the sky for passing events: Moonwake (a brighter Veyra and more $(l:native_fauna)Lantern Beetles$(/l) at night), Sporefall (a surge of $(l:native_fauna)Sporelings$(/l) and dense spores), and Deep Hush (more hostiles around deep explorers).
